initialExam.title: Mizoram PSC 2026
initialExam.description: Mizoram PSC conducts the Mizoram Civil Service Combined Competitive Examination for recruitment to administrative and allied service posts in Mizoram state government.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: General Studies, CSAT. Mains: English, Mizo, General Studies Papers, Optional Subject.
initialExam.jobRole: MCS Officer, MPS Officer, Administrative posts in Mizoram
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit mizoram.psc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Pension, Difficult area allowance

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: SC/ST: 5 years, as per state rules
